review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 preserve exact-key counting, live reads from the existing handler map, duplicate-registration semantics, compatibility, and restricted event-key typing. The exact writable scope covers the implementation and both regression owners without requiring gratuitous edits. Package configuration, CI ordering, ignore rules, and the supplied upstream build source support treating index.d.ts and dist as generated artifacts rather than separately maintained owners; verification must rebuild before checking root-entry consumers. TASK-IMPLEMENT and the dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY match the specified roles, with distinct eligible members supported by the supplied active trusted capability facts, including data.change, domain.state, and verifier-only testing.verification. This bounded synchronous API change does not itself require asynchronous or integration-boundary capabilities. A configured independent project reviewer is present for any applicable scenario-coverage prerequisite. No material unresolved DEC-001 or B/C variant is supplied in this case, so no decision-stage blocker is established. Expected readiness describes planning readiness, not permission to dispatch tasks or evidence that builds have run. The Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the differing manifest and evaluation source digests and original versus saved PRD digests have explicit, coherent domain and normalization provenance. Repository, team, model, policy, sampling, and budget fingerprints are supplied as Service-bound frozen facts. Review is based solely on the supplied evidence, without tools, code execution, independent digest recomputation, new human attestation, or candidate outputs.
